top_story.headline: New FARA registrant Starboard LLC signs on to represent a group acting for the State of Israel
top_story.dek: Olympic Media LLC, doing business as Starboard LLC, registered Oct. 28 with LDRS Group LLC on behalf of the State of Israel as its foreign principal.
paragraphs: Olympic Media LLC, doing business as Starboard LLC (registration #7788), registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act on October 28, 2026. Its foreign principal is LDRS Group LLC, listed as acting on behalf of the State of Israel (registration record).

In the Exhibit AB, the registrant describes the foreign principal's business as advertising and checks that it is a foreign or domestic organization, not a foreign government. It answers "No" to every question on whether the principal is supervised, owned, directed, controlled, financed or subsidized by a foreign government or party (Exhibit AB). The OCR text available does not show contract dates or fees.

The registration statement lists Ryan Patrick Coyne as chief executive and 100 percent owner. The company was organized in Richmond, Virginia, on January 20, 2017, and has an Alexandria, Virginia office. Will Ambruzs is listed as chief operating officer and Michael Reid as chief financial officer. Coyne also filed a short-form registration as an individual agent (registration statement, short-form).
No filing in this window shows a communication with the President, Vice President or a cabinet official, and no financial disclosures were available to weigh against it.

sections.headline: Office of Government Ethics Disclosures Include a Divestiture Notice and Ethics Compliance Certifications
paragraphs: The U.S. Office of Government Ethics published new filings in the review window, featuring a certificate of divestiture request alongside ethics agreement compliance certifications for Senate-confirmed presidential appointees. Routine transaction reports from other federal agencies are also tracked below.

items: Christopher Smith — Certificate of Divestiture OGE-2026-180, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. Only the fact of the divestiture is confirmed, not the asset.

Karen Sessions — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance, Consumer Product Safety Commission. The appointee certified completion of required resignations and divestitures under her ethics agreement, noting periodic transaction reports filed in September and October 2026.

Christopher Phelan — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance, Council of Economic Advisers. The appointee certified that he fulfilled all terms of his ethics agreement, citing a periodic transaction report filed on October 28, 2026.
Aaron Weisman — 278 Transaction (Request this Document), Department of Justice.

sections.headline: One new registrant for Israel-linked work, a new Dominican Republic contract and several terminations
paragraphs: One new registrant, one new foreign principal for an existing registrant, and three terminations of individual or principal relationships came in, along with routine supplemental statements and informational materials.

items: Olympic Media LLC (DBA Starboard LLC), registration #7788, registered 10/28/2026. Foreign principal: LDRS Group LLC on behalf of the State of Israel (Israel). Documents filed: registration statement, Exhibit AB, Exhibit C, short-form for Ryan Patrick Coyne.

DGA Group Government Relations LLC (#7321) added a new foreign principal, the Ministerio de la Presidencia de la Republica Dominicana (Dominican Republic), under a contract signed October 16, 2026 (amendment). The Exhibit AB says the firm will research and advocate for human rights best practices and communications strategies, support the ministry's outreach to U.S. government officials, thought leaders and the media, and advise on combating human trafficking and smuggling. It also covers consulting for Dominican public security forces on human rights standards tied to U.S. security-assistance vetting (the Leahy Amendment) and diplomatic efforts to build international support for the Multinational Security Support Mission concerning Haiti. The firm may also work with other Dominican ministries, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the activities may include lobbying and public relations (Exhibit AB). The OCR text shown does not give fees.

Steptoe LLP (#6653) reported that its relationship with the foreign principal Economic and Trade Mission at the Embassy of Israel ended September 30, 2026, and that Jeffrey Weiss and Eric Emerson ended their connection to that principal the same day (amendment).

Cornerstone Government Affairs (#6401) reported that Cooper William Moore ended his relationship with the foreign principal Embassy of the State of Qatar and with the registrant on August 12, 2026, when his employment ended (amendment).

Rational 360, Inc. (#7369) reported that Robert Frederick Van Raaphorst ended his connection with the registrant and with the foreign principal The Public Investment Fund effective October 2, 2026 (amendment).

sections.headline: No new registrations; seven terminations and a batch of amended quarterly reports
paragraphs: The 55 filings posted since October 30 were 29 third-quarter reports, 5 third-quarter no-activity reports, 4 third-quarter amendments, 3 third-quarter no-activity terminations, 3 second-quarter amendments, 3 first-quarter amendments, 2 third-quarter terminations, 2 third-quarter termination amendments (no activity), 2 fourth-quarter amendments, 1 second-quarter report and 1 second-quarter no-activity report. There were no new registrations and seven terminations. Of 48 activity reports, 35 carried a signal; the other 13 are counted only. Roughly two dozen signal reports in the same batch, such as the repeated Lyft amendments and the many Criscom Company municipal clients, are summarized below rather than listed row by row.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
